1238-5233-8323-8324.easyPrerequisites: You're able to play a land this turn.
1238-5233-8323-8324.description:
Play Boros Garrison
When Boros Garrison enters, it and Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger, causing you to create a Jace planeswalker token and put two loyalty counters on it.
Activate the Jace token by removing a loyalty counter from it.
Way of the Paradox triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and allowing you to play another land this turn.
Resolve the Jace token's ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Activate Heart of Kiran's crew ability by removing a loyalty counter from the Jace token.
The Jace token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having no loyalty.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability.
Repeat.

222-527-997-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

215-5434-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with different powers.
215-5434-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Loot from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Loot by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

856-3899-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-1183-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1011-2034-2728-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2034-2728-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2034-2728-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Fate Transfer's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

3532-5078-6769-7913.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-5078-6769-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Repeat.

676-1987-6991.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
676-1987-6991.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creature tokens.
676-1987-6991.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
676-1987-6991.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

5870-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5870-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Repeat from step 2.
5870-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

3490-6006-7075-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-6006-7075-7730.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2724-3194-4013.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Eldrazi Displacer. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

206-2933-4013-5798.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
647-3259-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
647-3259-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

2034-2308-7173.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-7173.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Virulent Emissary trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1274-3000-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1274-3000-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

3165-3532-5078-6259.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3165-3532-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

893-3967-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1003-4053-5686-6989.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

147-2034-3440.description:
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Demonic Gifts, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Demonic Gifts.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2128-3227.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature, or land that can produce at least {U} the turn it enters the battlefield.
1987-2128-3227.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U} due to Hinata, blinking Scrivener and the permanent tapped for mana in step 1.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1417-3705-4050-6896.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

1987-4316-4423-5116.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus by tapping them, adding {3}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1863-3946-6762.notablePrerequisites: Exploration Broodship has three or more charge counters on it.
1863-3946-6762.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

654-1231-2292-6644.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

6443-6527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creature tokens.
6443-6527.description:
Cast Sway of the Stars by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing each player to shuffle their hand, graveyard and all permanents they own into their library, then causing each player to draw seven cards and set their life total to 7.
Zurgo triggers for each creature token you control that leaves the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose at least 7 life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

3470-5414-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
3470-5414-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger that many times.
Resolve all Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

997-2835-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-2835-6249--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

465-643-1322-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness

1242-3143-3197-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1242-3143-3197-4613.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Xavier Sal using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

240-526-2034.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Egg creature tokens.
240-526-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg, adding {C}{C}.
When the Egg dies, Atla Palani triggers, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, if it has power 4 or greater, Life Finds a Way triggers, creating a copy of an Egg token you control.
Repeat.
240-526-2034.notes: This combo will only fetch every creature in your library if all creatures have power 4 or greater. You may use additional Egg tokens to grab as many creatures as possible.

618-3662-4377-4836.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} each extra turn
618-3662-4377-4836.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your end step, Kiki-Jiki triggers, but you cannot sacrifice the Izzet Chemister token due to The Master.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

978-1419-1429-4853.notablePrerequisites:
Breya's Apprentice does not have summoning sickness.
Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
978-1419-1429-4853.description:
Activate Breya's Apprentice by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Breya's Apprentice.
Resolve the Lesser Masticore trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Breya's Apprentice ability, either giving target creature +2/+0 until end of turn, or exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Repeat.

905-4968.notablePrerequisites: Deathbringer Thoctar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
905-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying the targeted creature.
When the creature dies, Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat as desired.
You may also repeat this combo whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

380-803-2743-3657.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Miirym triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Biovisionary to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time.
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
When Biovisionary enters the battlefield, Miirym triggers, creating a token copy of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

3408-4067.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
3408-4067.description:
Activate Talas Researcher by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Talas Researcher.
Repeat.

1350-2713-4617-5115.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin twice by paying {2}, giving any two creatures trample until end of turn.
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}, giving any creature trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by paying {1}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {W}, returning Soulbright Flamekin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

2292-2523-2869.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Viscera Seer that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

586-2232-2506.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {2}{B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Molten Echoes.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix with haste.
The Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
